title: MetaHate: A Dataset for Unifying Efforts on Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis to quantify the percentage of hate speech posts referencing nationalities (categorized under NORP entities).
Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis to quantify the frequency of hate speech targeting religious groups (categorized under NORP entities).
Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis to quantify the frequency of hate speech directed at political groups or affiliations (categorized under NORP entities).
Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling and word cloud analysis to identify clusters of hateful content containing explicitly racist themes and keywords.
Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling and word cloud analysis isolating topics characterized by homophobic slurs and targeted hate against sexual minorities.
Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling identifying specific themes of fatphobia and body-shaming through frequency analysis of related derogatory terms.
Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling and t-SNE clustering mapping semantic relationships of derogatory and sexist terms targeting women.
